subject: Orion Retail discovery — integration fit, SDK changes, and next technical steps
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@orion-retail.com>, Priya Desai <priya@orion-retail.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Orion Retail discovery — integration fit, SDK changes, and next technical steps

Sam / Priya — thanks again for a great discussion this morning. High-level recap and proposed next steps so we have a single place to align: 

Summary of pain & goals (what I heard)
- Product search relevance is inconsistent for long-tail SKUs; re-ranking is manual and takes too long.
- Peak latency during flash sales spikes beyond your 200ms SLO for product detail and recommendation endpoints.
- You want an emb+rerank flow for retrieval-first search and a streaming answer path for chat-style product assistants on mobile.

Redwood fit (short)
- Embeddings + reranker for retrieval: lightweight encoding at ingest, upsert to vector index (we recommend 1536-d float16 quantized), then single-stage re-rank model for top-K.
- Streaming generative assistant with function-calling to surface product metadata and to trigger add-to-cart actions.
- SDK work: small client-side hooks for streaming, plus server-side changes for structured outputs (JSON schemas) and an optional KV prefix cache to speed up repeated queries.

Technical constraints we discussed
- Max latency target: 200ms p95 for recommendation calls (typical token lengths under 64).
- Data residency: US only; no PII leaves your VPC during PoC.
- Throughput: baseline 50 qps for search, with ability to burst to 400 qps during sales.

Action items & owners
- Orion: provide a sample of 5k product records plus 500 representative queries (Sam) — due EOD 6/16.
- Redwood (Sergio): propose an initial infra sizing and SDK change matrix by 6/15.
- Redwood (Ava): demo plan for streaming + funcalls and structured outputs (mock flows) — target week of 6/21.
- Joint decision: agree on success metrics (latency p95, top-10 NDCG on rerank) before PoC kickoff.

Attachments: I attached an "orion_integration_requirements_v1.pdf" that captures the items you called out; also included a draft "redwood_sdk_change_matrix.xlsx" with the minimal SDK hooks to enable streaming + structured outputs.

If that aligns, we can lock in an initial PoC start on 6/24 with a two-week evaluation window. Let me know any corrections.

Best,
Jonas

Jonas — thanks, this is helpful and captures the conversation well. Quick clarifications from our side: 

- The 200ms p95 target is a hard constraint for our mobile checkout flow; if we can hit 150ms at baseline that's ideal.
- The product dataset will include images and HTML descriptions; for the first PoC we only need text+metadata embeddings.
- Security: we can share redacted telemetry and sample records via S3 with short-lived creds. Priya will send the link.

We can aim to deliver the 5k sample + queries by 6/16. One ask for your SDK team: can you confirm the minimum server-side dependency (runtime + quantization profile) we should expect if we run the Redwood Private appliance for the PoC? We want to evaluate Hosted vs Private cost tradeoffs quickly.

I also looped in Priya since she'll manage the data share and procurement gating.

Thanks — Sam
Sam Patel

Sam / Priya — thanks for the quick confirmation. I'm attaching a short infra sketch and an SDK change matrix ("redwood_sdk_change_matrix.xlsx"). Key technical notes from my side: 

- Embedding recommendations: 1536 dims, use QLoRA-like quantization to float16 or int8 per your storage constraints. For Orion PoC I'd suggest float16 quantized index for throughput.
- Rerank flow: perform retrieval from your vector store (we'll send a connector for Pinecone/Weaviate/FAISS) that returns top-200, then server-side rerank using a small transformer reranker (100-300ms per request baseline — we will optimize with prefix caching and batching).
- Streaming assistant: our SDK exposes a chunked streaming interface + function-calling hooks. For your add-to-cart function we can accept a validated JSON schema and emit structured events (example schema attached) which your frontend can map to CTA flows.
- Private appliance: minimally requires CUDA 11.8, 40GB GPU with 16-bit support for reasonable throughput. For your burst requirements we recommend a two-node Dedicated pool with autoscaling.

Open questions for PoC scope: 
1) Do you want an end-to-end PoC (ingest -> index -> rerank -> streaming assistant) or a two-phase approach (phase A: index+rerank evaluation; phase B: streaming + funcall)?
2) Which vector store will you use for the PoC (we can run a short matrix for managed vs self-hosted options)?

I'll publish the infra sketch and initial cost estimate by 6/15.

Thanks,
Sergio

Sam / Priya — great, appreciate the quick turnaround. Short confirmation and final asks so procurement and engineering can plan: 

Confirmed:
- PoC scope: Phase A: ingest 5k products + run embedding/retrieval + rerank evaluation (2 weeks). Phase B (optional): streaming assistant + funcalls for mobile (follow-on sprint).
- Success metrics: latency p95 < 200ms (target 150ms), rerank top-10 NDCG improvement over current baseline, and memory footprint < 16GB per shard for the index.
- Data delivery: Priya will share S3 link with short-lived creds by 6/16.

Final asks from Orion (before PoC start 6/24):
1) Confirm vector store choice or let us run the managed connector (Sam).
2) Share sample traffic profile (qps by hour) for a representative day (Priya).
3) Confirm procurement contact and PO gating for a short-term Dedicated trial if needed (Sam/Priya).

Next steps (calendar):
- 6/15: Redwood (Sergio) sends infra + cost estimate and the required runtime spec for Private appliance.
- 6/16: Orion sends sample data + traffic profile.
- 6/18: 30-min tech alignment call to finalize index parameters (Jonas/Sergio/Ava + Orion eng).
- 6/24: Expected PoC kickoff (ingest & rerank eval).

I'll follow up with a calendar invite for the 6/18 alignment call and a shared Drive folder with the attachments and evaluation checklist. Thanks again — we'll aim to keep the PoC narrow and measurable.

Best,
Jonas
